text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey! Kiseki-chan, how do you draw your manga?"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious too! How do you come up with
such interesting stories!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, good question!
The secret is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because I've read tons of interesting stories!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can kinda tell!
What kind of stories are actually 'entertaining'!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I can intuitively tell
what kind of story will get everyone hyped up—...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
……I can just tell,
right away which one's more entertaining when you compare them.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The first is a tale of miracles.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Having conquered the rainy Kikuka Sho, she enters the Takarazuka Kinen, the ultimate battle to determine the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she wowed everyone
by running as a front-runner and completely
shutting down the closers with brilliant late kicks.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The second is the story of Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With her natural athletic prowess and extraordinary mental fortitude,
she became the fifth Triple Tiara winner in history.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And she announced her entry into the Japan Cup,
a race that brings together the world's finest Umamusume to determine number one.
...All for the sake of the next summit.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Which one sounds more fun?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Which one would make the Japan Cup
a more interesting race?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Which of them being the protagonist would—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Even so...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, I will surpass it!
I'll create a "fun" that beats that fun!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (We are going to create it ourselves!!)
The day of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And next to take the stage:
The great Umamusume, Cheval Grand!
And the music-loving Umamusume, Sounds of Earth!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Such incredible passion...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grandioso!!
A fierce rhythm echoes through the air.
And at its very center—
(Woooooaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Now, I wonder if they'll make their appearance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Yes. That's her.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Here you are, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've finally reached it.
A race with you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to this.
To this showdown.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………Me too.
My heart's pounding at the thought of beating you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (—Watching your eyes sparkle like that once again...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (To you, who fits the role of protagonist better than anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You, the "Protagonist"...
Almond Eye, I will—!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I want to overcome it and become the main character!!
